paragraphs: R. Natan bar Tovi. When R. Zeira was weakened by study, he sat at R. Natan bar Tovi's doorway, saying he would rise before passing rabbis and receive reward. Heilprin reports that Natan learned a ruling in R. Yoḥanan’s name from R. Zeira and repeated it forty times, Berakhot 28a. In R. Yoḥanan's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Tefillat HaShaḥar, mishnah 1.
